entries.note: Incoming straddler tail: final 9 words [0x101000,0x101024) that COMPLETE a truncated fixed-stride 0x50-byte (20-word) float/param record begun at 0x100FD4 in chunk 15. word[11] at 0x101000=0x42340000 (=45.0f). Fixed-stride 0x50-byte (20-word) record table, 4 records: R0@0x101024, R1@0x101074, R2@0x1010C4, R3@0x101114 (stride 0x50 confirmed by repeating header). Header pattern word[0]=0x00000003 or 0x00000004 (e.g. 0x101024=0x04, 0x101074=0x04, 0x1010C4=0x03, 0x101114=0x03), word[1]=0x00000064 (=100), word[2]=small (0x01/0x02). Each record body then holds packed small ints (0x00000001, 0x000200FF, 0x00FF0000, 0x00A80000) and a run of IEEE floats (0x42880000=68.0, 0x42C20000=97.0, 0x41E80000=29.0, 0x42A60000=83.0, 0x427C0000=63.0...). R3 tail [0x101138,0x101164) carries 0xC1xx-prefixed floats interleaved with ascending index words (0xC1B9344A, 0x00000011, 0xC2085C5B, 0x00000013, 0xC21D9BD2, 0x00000015...). Table ends at 0x101164: the word there is 0x00000019 (followed by 0xC225A56B float, 0x0000001B), an index+float ramp, NOT a 0x00000003/4 + 0x00000064 record header — so the fixed-stride table terminates here. [adversarial fix: earlier draft mis-cited 0x00010002, which is actually at RAM 0x80171164 = a different z64 offset 0x101564, not z64 0x101164]. No field names asserted (hypothesis: per-record float param set keyed by count=100). [name-token: data_00101024_stride50_records]

[name-token: data_00101164_floatramp_indexed]
